biotools.summary: This package contains a collection of functions (written as shiny modules) for the visualisation and the statistical analysis of omics data. These plots can be displayed individually or embedded in a global Shiny module. Additionaly, it is possible to integrate third party modules to the main interface of the package omXplore.
